Maya (CSM): Hey all — kicking off Hummingbird activation. Goal: get a production-ready integration and handoff to ops in 6 weeks. Quick ask: please drop 1) primary stakeholder, 2) hard constraints (data, compliance, maintenance windows), 3) any blockers for Week 1.
Gwen (Hummingbird PM): Thanks Maya — hi team. Primary stakeholders: Gwen (PM), Ravi (SRE), Ana (Security). Constraint: VPC peering only, no public egress for model payloads. Maintenance window: Tue/Wed 02:00-04:00 PT.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): Noted on VPC peering. We'll need a small NAT for outbound model fetches if they choose hosted model variants — otherwise we can use private deployment. Will prep two suggested architecture diagrams by EOD Friday.
Maya (CSM): Prefer private deployment given their compliance note. Initial success criteria proposal: 1) end-to-end inference from app -> Redwood Private in staging, 2) median tail latency < 400ms for typical 512-token calls, 3) baseline quality: >= 85% pass rate on their 50-case eval set, 4) enablement session completed and OKR alignment. Thoughts?
Liam (Onboarding Eng): I can own staging infra and smoke tests. Week 1: network + credentials, Week 2: model onboarding + eval harness, Week 3: pilot traffic, Week 4–5: performance tuning and training, Week 6: handoff + runbook.
Naya (AE): Renewal note — current contract upsell window is 10 months out. If we hit pilot success by Week 6, renewal velocity is high. Risk: if integration drags past Week 8 or quality < 80%, renewal becomes a negotiation point. Flagging commercial touchpoints.
Gwen (Hummingbird PM): Appreciate the timeline. One nuance: our legal needs SOC2 attestation before production onboarding. We have a compliance review scheduled for 2 weeks from now. Could delay prod by ~1–2 weeks if anything pops up.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): OK — we'll decouple staging from prod. Plan: staging private cluster that mirrors prod but uses masked data. That should let us validate performance and quality before attestation completes.
Maya (CSM): Great. For enablement — propose a 90-minute workshop in Week 5 for power users + ops. Deliverables: runbook doc, quickstart repo, short training video. Gwen: who's the attendee for training?
Gwen (Hummingbird PM): I'll invite the PMs + 2 SREs + 1 data owner.
Liam (Onboarding Eng): Quick checklist I'm tracking: SSH keys, KMS access, VPC peering, model repo access, sample traffic, eval cases. I'll paste a snippet of the checklist here:
```
- network: confirm VPC CIDRs
- credentials: service account + KMS role
- data: masked sample set (<=1000 rows)
- eval: 50 canonical prompts
```
Arjun (Solutions Eng): Also adding performance gating: p95 < 700ms on staging under 50rps burst. If we blow that, we'll propose quantized weights or dedicated capacity.
Maya (CSM): Communication plan: weekly 30-min sync (Wednesdays 10am PT) + async updates in this thread. If a blocker emerges, call out with subject [BLOCKER].
Gwen (Hummingbird PM): Confirm weekly sync works. Also want a short feedback capture after the pilot — can we push a 5-question Notion form and a 3-question CSAT after Week 4?
Maya (CSM): Yes — we'll run both. Notion form for qualitative notes, CSAT for immediate sentiment. I'll own the feedback deck and pass it to Naya for commercial signals.
Naya (AE): I'll monitor win-rates and early adoption metrics. If we see >20% adoption among targeted teams within 30 days of handoff, that's a strong renewal signal.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Hummingbird Onboarding Weekly" Wed 10:00 PT — invite sent to participants.
Maya (CSM): Action items summary: Arjun: diagrams + staging plan by Fri; Liam: checklist + infra ready by next Tue; Gwen: confirm compliance calendar and attendee list; Naya: draft renewal watch metrics; I'll book enablement slot Week 5 and draft feedback form.
Gwen (Hummingbird PM): Thanks everyone — will confirm attendees and loop in Ravi for the SRE details.
Liam (Onboarding Eng): Ping me if you need any sample logs or a test token.
Maya (CSM): Closing note — priority is low-friction staging so we can validate metrics before legal gating. Let's keep blockers visible. :thumbsup:
